");
  background-repeat:no-repeat;
  background-size:200% 200%;
  background-color:#08090b;
  box-shadow:0 24px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.20);
}
.light .board-kv,.light2 .board-kv{border-color:rgba(17,19,23,.12);box-shadow:0 20px 46px rgba(17,19,23,.10)}
.board-kv:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.03);pointer-events:none}

#cover .cover-grid{grid-template-columns:.94fr 1.06fr!important;gap:40px!important;align-items:center!important}
#cover .cover-copy p{max-width:590px!important}
#cover .display{font-size:clamp(48px,6.2vw,84px)!important}
.cover-kv{min-height:620px;background-position:0% 0%}
.story-kv{min-height:560px;background-position:100% 0%;margin-bottom:24px}
.oops-kv{min-height:520px;background-position:0% 100%;margin-bottom:28px}
.mission-kv{min-height:420px;background-position:100% 100%;margin-bottom:28px}

.kv-note{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;font-size:10px;line-height:1.5;letter-spacing:.08em;color:#8a929a;margin-top:10px}

.story-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:28px;align-items:start}

</style>


<style id="v29-one-plate-layout">
/* V29 — one visual per plate, explanation below, no cramped side-by-side image/text */

section{
  padding-top:92px!important;
  padding-bottom:92px!important;
}
.wrap{
  width:min(1180px,calc(100% - 64px))!important;
}

/* General heading rhythm */
.split{
  display:block!important;
  margin-bottom:30px!important;
}
.split > div:first-child{
  max-width:860px!important;
}
.split > p{
  margin-top:18px!important;
  max-width:780px!important;
}
.section-title{
  font-size:clamp(34px,3.6vw,50px)!important;
  line-height:1.12!important;
}
.lead{
  font-size:16px!important;
  line-height:1.8!important;
  max-width:780px!important;
}

/* One full-width visual plate */
.kv-stack{
  margin:28px 0 42px!important;
}
.board-kv{
  width:100%!important;
  min-height:0!important;
  aspect-ratio:3 / 2!important;
  background-size:200% 200%!important;
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.10)!important;
  box-shadow:0 24px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.18)!important;
}
.light .board-kv,.light2 .board-kv{
  border-color:rgba(17,19,23,.14)!important;
  box-shadow:0 20px 46px rgba(17,19,23,.10)!important;
}
.kv-note{
  margin-top:10px!important;
  display:flex!important;
  justify-content:space-between!important;
  align-items:flex-start!important;
  gap:18px!important;
  font-size:11px!important;
  line-height:1.55!important;
}

/* Cover becomes a single visual card + copy below */
#cover{
  min-height:auto!important;
  padding-top:90px!important;
}
#cover .cover-grid{
  display:block!important;
}
#cover .cover-copy{
  max-width:860px!important;
  margin:0 0 28px!important;
}
#cover .display{
  font-size:clamp(48px,6vw,82px)!important;
}
#cover .cover-copy p{
  max-width:760px!important;
}
.cover-kv{
  aspect-ratio:3 / 2!important;
  min-height:0!important;
  background-position:0% 0%!important;
}

/* Story: visual first, copy after */
.story-grid{
  display:block!important;
}
.story-kv{
  aspect-ratio:3 / 2!important;
  min-height:0!important;
  margin-bottom:0!important;
  background-position:100% 0%!important;
}
.story-copy{
  margin-top:34px!important;
  max-width:880px!important;
  border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16)!important;
  padding-top:22px!important;
}
.story-copy h3{
  max-width:680px!important;
}
.legend{
  max-width:880px!important;
}
.story-path{
  margin-top:34px!important;
}

/* OOPS: full-width visual, then full-width system blocks below */
.oops-kv{
  aspect-ratio:3 / 2!important;
  min-height:0!important;
  margin-bottom:0!important;
  background-position:0% 100%!important;
}
#oops .base-lock,
#oops .base-lockup{
  display:grid!important;
  grid-template-columns:.72fr 1.28fr!important;
  margin-top:34px!important;
}
#oops .ops-grid{
  margin-top:36px!important;
}

/* Mission: full-width visual, explanation and weekly plan below */
.mission-kv{
  aspect-ratio:3 / 2!important;
  min-height:0!important;
  margin-bottom:0!important;
  background-position:100% 100%!important;
}
#oct .mission,
#oct .mission-hero{
  display:grid!important;
  grid-template-columns:.72fr 1.28fr!important;
  margin-top:34px!important;
}
#oct .weeks{
  margin-top:34px!important;
}

/* Remove any 'image + description squeezed in one row' patterns */
.member-engine,.commercial{
  gap:52px!important;
}

/* Better contrast */
.dark .lead,.dark2 .lead{color:#c1c7cc!important}
.dark .story-copy p,.dark2 .story-copy p{color:#adb5bb!important}
.week ul{color:#9da5ac!important}
.kpi span{color:#aab1b7!important}

/* keep English only as brand/product language */
.kicker{font-size:11px!important}
.caption{font-size:12px!important}

@media(max-width:980px){
  .board-kv{aspect-ratio:3 / 2!important}
  #oops .base-lock,#oops .base-lockup,#oct .mission,#oct .mission-hero{
    grid-template-columns:1fr!important;
  }
}
@media(max-width:650px){
  .wrap{width:min(100% - 28px,1180px)!important}
  .board-kv{aspect-ratio:4 / 3!important}
  .kv-note{display:block!important}
  .kv-note span{display:block!important;margin-bottom:5px!important}
}
</style>


<style id="v30-motion">
/* ===== motion system adapted from v17 ===== */
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{position:relative}
#stars{
  position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:0;opacity:.22;pointer-events:none;
}
body > nav, body > section{position:relative;z-index:2}
.scroll-progress{
  position:fixed;left:0;right:0;top:59px;height:2px;z-index:120;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.035);pointer-events:none
}
.scroll-progress span{
  display:block;height:100%;width:0;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,#6f9fa1,#9b8cb7,#d2d5d6);
  box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(111,159,161,.45)
}
.reveal{
  opacity:0;
  transform:translateY(22px);
  transition:opacity .78s ease,transform .78s ease;
}
.reveal.on{opacity:1;transform:none}
.reveal-delay-1{transition-delay:.08s}
.reveal-delay-2{transition-delay:.16s}
.reveal-delay-3{transition-delay:.24s}

/* animated line/orbit overlays on the four luxury plates */
.board-kv{isolation:isolate}
.board-kv:before{
  content:"";
  position:absolute;
  width:42%;aspect-ratio:1;
  right:6%;top:12%;
  border:1px solid rgba(216,225,228,.20);
  border-radius:50%;
  z-index:3;
  pointer-events:none;
  animation:portalBreath 4.8s ease-in-out infinite;
}
.board-kv:after{
  content:"";
  position:absolute;
  width:34%;aspect-ratio:1;
  right:10%;top:16%;
  border-radius:50%;
  border-top:1.5px solid rgba(235,238,239,.58);
  border-right:1.5px solid transparent;
  border-bottom:1px solid rgba(111,159,161,.18);
  border-left:1.5px solid transparent;
  z-index:3;
  pointer-events:none;
  animation:portalSpin 15s linear infinite;
  box-shadow:0 0 22px rgba(111,159,161,.06)
}
.story-kv:after{animation-duration:19s;animation-direction:reverse}
.oops-kv:after{animation-duration:13s}
.mission-kv:after{animation-duration:10s}
@keyframes portalSpin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
@keyframes portalBreath{50%{transform:scale(1.045);opacity:.62}}

/* signal dots — subtle, not gaming UI */
.signal-dot{
  position:absolute;width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;
  background:#e3e7e8;box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(111,159,161,.75);
  z-index:4;pointer-events:none;
}
.signal-dot:after{
  content:"";position:absolute;inset:-7px;border:1px solid rgba(111,159,161,.35);
  border-radius:50%;animation:ping 2.8s ease-out infinite
}
.signal-dot.s1{right:18%;top:21%}.signal-dot.s2{right:32%;top:57%;animation:drift1 7s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes ping{to{transform:scale(2.2);opacity:0}}
@keyframes drift1{50%{transform:translate(9px,-8px)}}

/* New content modules */
.content-engine-grid{
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);
  border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);
  border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);
}
.ce-card{padding:22px 18px;border-right:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.09);min-height:190px}
.ce-card:last-child{border-right:0}
.ce-card small,.academy-card small,.loop-card small{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.08em;color:#86aaac;font-weight:800}
.ce-card b,.academy-card b,.loop-card b{display:block;font-size:16px;margin:9px 0}
.ce-card p{font-size:13px;line-height:1.72;color:#a6aeb5;margin:0}
.growth-rhythm{
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);margin-top:30px;
  border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12)
}
.growth-rhythm>div{padding:18px 18px 0;border-right:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08)}
.growth-rhythm>div:last-child{border-right:0}
.growth-rhythm small{font-size:10px;color:#86aaac;font-weight:800}
.growth-rhythm b{display:block;font-size:14px;margin:8px 0}
.growth-rhythm span{font-size:12px;line-height:1.6;color:#929ba3}

.academy-grid{
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);
  border-top:1px solid var(--line-dark);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-dark)
}
.academy-card{padding:24px 22px;border-right:1px solid var(--line-dark);min-height:210px}
.academy-card:last-child{border-right:0}
.academy-card small{color:#4f7779}
.academy-card p{font-size:13px;line-height:1.7;color:#505b64}
.academy-card span{font-size:11px;line-height:1.55;color:#69737b}
.academy-path{
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);margin-top:28px;
  border-top:1px solid var(--line-dark);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-dark)
}
.academy-path>div{padding:17px 14px;border-right:1px solid var(--line-dark)}
.academy-path>div:last-child{border-right:0}
.academy-path small{font-size:10px;color:#4f7779;font-weight:800}
.academy-path b{display:block;font-size:13px;margin:7px 0}
.academy-path span{font-size:11px;line-height:1.5;color:#5c666f}

.loop-grid{
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);
  border-top:1px solid var(--line-dark)
}
.loop-card{padding:22px 20px;border-right:1px solid var(--line-dark);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-dark);min-height:200px}
.loop-card:nth-child(3n){border-right:0}
.loop-card small{color:#4f7779}
.loop-card p{font-size:12px;font-weight:800;color:#273035;margin:9px 0}
.loop-card span{font-size:12px;line-height:1.65;color:#59636c}

@media(max-width:980px){
  .content-engine-grid,.academy-grid,.academy-path,.loop-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
  .ce-card:nth-child(2n),.academy-card:nth-child(2n),.loop-card:nth-child(2n){border-right:0}
}
@media(max-width:650px){
  .content-engine-grid,.growth-rhythm,.academy-grid,.academy-path,.loop-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .ce-card,.growth-rhythm>div,.academy-card,.academy-path>div,.loop-card{
    border-right:0;border-bottom:1px solid currentColor
  }
  .scroll-progress{top:59px}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){
  .reveal{opacity:1!important;transform:none!important;transition:none!important}
  .board-kv:before,.board-kv:after,.signal-dot,.signal-dot:after{animation:none!important}
}
</style>


<style id="v31-revenue">
.rev-models{

<style id="v32-readable-focused-color">
/* ===== V32: bigger text, stronger emphasis, clearer page-by-page differentiation ===== */
:root{
  --accent-teal:#78a8ab;
  --accent-violet:#a89ac8;
  --accent-gold:#d8c7a0;
  --accent-blue:#90a8cc;
  --accent-rose:#c59db4;
  --text-dark-strong:#263038;
  --text-dark:#48535d;
  --text-dark-soft:#66727b;
  --text-light-strong:#f2efe8;
  --text-light:#cbd1d6;
  --text-light-soft:#9fa8b0;
}
.wrap{width:min(1200px,calc(100% - 56px))!important}
section{padding-top:98px!important;padding-bottom:98px!important}
.kicker{
  font-size:11.5px!important;
  letter-spacing:.13em!important;
  font-weight:900!important;
  margin-bottom:16px!important;
}
.section-title{
  font-size:clamp(36px,4.1vw,58px)!important;
  line-height:1.12!important;
  letter-spacing:-.03em!important;
  max-width:980px!important;
}
.goal-inline{
  display:inline-block;
  margin-top:12px;
  font-size:clamp(18px,1.55vw,22px);
  line-height:1.5;
  letter-spacing:-.01em;
  color:inherit;
  opacity:.94;
}
.display{
  font-size:clamp(52px,6.3vw,92px)!important;
  line-height:.9!important;
}
.lead{
  font-size:17px!important;
  line-height:1.9!important;
  max-width:860px!important;
}
.body,.cover-copy p,.story-copy p,.engine-note p,.commercial p,.mcopy p,.rev-card p,.cash-card p,.revenue-note span{
  font-size:15px!important;
  line-height:1.82!important;
}
.problem p,.ops-item ul,.jstep span,.input span,.model span,.biz-flow span,.day span,.deliv span,.road p,.road li,
.ce-card p,.growth-rhythm span,.academy-card p,.academy-card span,.academy-path span,.loop-card span,.finance-rules span{
  font-size:13.5px!important;
  line-height:1.72!important;
}
.problem b,.ops-item b,.jstep b,.input b,.academy-card b,.loop-card b,.ce-card b,.cash-card b,.finance-rules b{
  font-size:17px!important;
}
.row > *, .metric > *, .scenario-row > *{
  font-size:12.5px!important;
  line-height:1.65!important;
}
.row.head > *, .metric.head > *, .scenario-row.head > *{
  font-size:10.5px!important;
  font-weight:900!important;
}
.kpi b{font-size:22px!important}
.kpi span{font-size:11px!important}
.rev-card b{font-size:20px!important}
.commercial h3,.scenario-title h3,.story-copy h3{
  font-size:32px!important;
  line-height:1.24!important;
}

/* Stronger emphasis */
strong, b{font-weight:800}
.key{
  font-weight:900!important;
  color:inherit!important;
  background:linear-gradient(transparent 58%, rgba(120,168,171,.42) 0)!important;
  padding:0 .06em;
  border-radius:2px;
}
.dark .key,.dark2 .key{
  background:linear-gradient(transparent 58%, rgba(120,168,171,.34) 0)!important;
  color:var(--text-light-strong)!important;
}
.note-strong{
  font-weight:900!important;
  color:inherit!important;
}
.highlight-box{
  margin-top:18px;
  padding:16px 18px;
  border-left:3px solid var(--accent-teal);
  background:rgba(120,168,171,.08);
  font-size:15px;
  line-height:1.75;
}

/* Page-by-page color differentiation */
#cover{background:
  radial-gradient(circle at 82% 18%, rgba(168,154,200,.08), transparent 22%),
  radial-gradient(circle at 15% 82%, rgba(120,168,171,.08), transparent 22%),
  #090a0c!important}
#story{background:
  linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(168,154,200,.06), transparent 18%),
  #0e0f13!important}
#oops{background:
  linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(120,168,171,.06), transparent 18%),
  #f1efe9!important}
#member{background:
  linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(144,168,204,.08), transparent 18%),
  #12161b!important}
#content-growth{background:
  linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(120,168,171,.06), transparent 18%),
  #0f1317!important}
#academy{background:
  linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(216,199,160,.08), transparent 18%),
  #f0ece4!important}
#partner{background:
  linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(168,154,200,.07), transparent 18%),
  #ddd9d1!important}
section[id="revenue"]{background:
  linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(197,157,180,.07), transparent 18%),
  #14161b!important}
#growth-loops{background:
  linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(144,168,204,.07), transparent 18%),
  #ddd9d1!important}
#oct{background:
  linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(120,168,171,.08), transparent 18%),
  #0b0d10!important}
#role{background:
  linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(216,199,160,.08), transparent 18%),
  #ddd9d1!important}

#cover .kicker{color:var(--accent-violet)!important}
#story .kicker{color:var(--accent-violet)!important}
#oops .kicker{color:#4d7f81!important}
#member .kicker{color:var(--accent-blue)!important}
#content-growth .kicker{color:var(--accent-teal)!important}
#academy .kicker{color:#7b6b45!important}
#partner .kicker{color:#7a6799!important}
#revenue .kicker{color:#c09cb3!important}
#growth-loops .kicker{color:#58709a!important}
#oct .kicker{color:var(--accent-teal)!important}
#role .kicker{color:#7b6b45!important}

/* Better contrast throughout */

/* Plates + captions */

/* Mobile */

<style id="v35-investor-universe-palette">
:root{
  --iv-bg:#05080b;
  --iv-bg2:#0a0f14;
  --iv-paper:#0d1318;
  --iv-ink:#f2efe8;
  --iv-muted:#aeb9bb;
  --iv-muted2:#89969d;
  --iv-gold:#d7b47a;
  --iv-gold2:#f0d7a7;
  --iv-cyan:#84dce2;
  --iv-cyan2:#bdf7f3;
  --iv-line:rgba(255,255,255,.09);
  --iv-glass:rgba(10,15,20,.72);
}

/* alternate every section: deep / lighter deep */
body{background:var(--iv-bg)!important;color:var(--iv-ink)!important}
body > section{
  color:var(--iv-ink)!important;
  border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.035);
}
body > section:nth-of-type(odd){
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 18% 12%,rgba(132,220,226,.055),transparent 27%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 84% 28%,rgba(215,180,122,.038),transparent 30%),
    linear-gradient(180deg,#05080b,#080d12)!important;
}
body > section:nth-of-type(even){
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 82% 12%,rgba(132,220,226,.045),transparent 28%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 20% 82%,rgba(215,180,122,.035),transparent 32%),
    linear-gradient(180deg,#0d1318,#0a0f14)!important;
}

/* cover stays darkest */
#cover{
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 20% 10%,rgba(132,220,226,.06),transparent 24%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 82% 34%,rgba(215,180,122,.05),transparent 27%),
    linear-gradient(180deg,#040609,#070b0f 45%,#05080b)!important;
}

/* all copy contrasts against both backgrounds */
body > section .section-title,
body > section h1,
body > section h2,
body > section h3,
body > section h4,
body > section b,
body > section strong{
  color:var(--iv-ink)!important;
}
body > section .lead,
body > section p,
body > section li,
body > section span,
body > section .body,
body > section .caption{
  color:var(--iv-muted)!important;
}
body > section small,
body > section .meta{
  color:#95a2a8!important;
}

/* Investor Universe accents */
body > section .kicker{
  color:var(--iv-cyan)!important;
}
body > section .key{
  color:var(--iv-ink)!important;
  background:linear-gradient(transparent 57%,rgba(132,220,226,.22) 0)!important;
}
body > section .goal-inline{
  color:#dce8e8!important;
}
body > section a{color:var(--iv-cyan2)!important}

/* cards / modules: keep layout, change only surfaces + text */
.problem,.ops-item,.ce-card,.academy-card,.loop-card,.rev-card,.cash-card,.deliv,
.road>div,.benchmark-card,.swot-card,.model,.week,.kpi,.day,.jstep,.input,
.member-engine,.commercial,.engine,.retainer>div,.finance-rules>div,
.online-ops,.online-op{
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.018)!important;
  border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.09)!important;
}
body > section [class*="card"]{
  border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.09)!important;
}
body > section [class*="table"],
body > section .row,
body > section .metric,
body > section .scenario-row,
body > section .timeline,
body > section .academy-path,
body > section .content-engine-grid,
body > section .growth-rhythm,
body > section .finance-rules,
body > section .rev-models,
body > section .cash-grid,
body > section .online-ops-grid{
  border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.09)!important;
}
body > section .row>*,
body > section .metric>*,
body > section .scenario-row>*{
  border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.07)!important;
  color:#b8c2c5!important;
}
body > section .row.head>*,
body > section .metric.head>*,
body > section .scenario-row.head>*{
  color:var(--iv-cyan)!important;
}
body > section .serial{color:#91a0a6!important}
body > section .thesis,
body > section .highlight-box{
  color:var(--iv-ink)!important;
  border-color:var(--iv-cyan)!important;
  background:rgba(132,220,226,.035)!important;
}

/* preserve luxury image plates */
.board-kv{
  background-color:#05080b!important;
  border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.10)!important;
}
.kv-note,.kv-note span{color:#aeb9bb!important}

/* revenue accent */
.rev-card b,.scenario-row strong,.retainer b,.kpi b{color:var(--iv-gold2)!important}

/* Market benchmark cards */
.benchmark-grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);
  gap:14px;
}
.benchmark-card{
  min-height:220px;
  border:1px solid var(--iv-line);
  border-radius:20px;
  padding:22px;
}
.benchmark-card small{
  display:block;
  font-size:10px;
  letter-spacing:.11em;
  color:var(--iv-cyan)!important;
  font-weight:800;
}
.benchmark-card b{
  display:block;
  font-size:22px;
  margin:10px 0 8px;
}
.benchmark-card p{
  margin:0 0 14px;
}
.benchmark-card span{
  display:block;
  padding-top:12px;
  border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);
  color:#a9b5b8!important;
}

/* SWOT */
.swot-grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;
  gap:14px;
}
.swot-card{
  min-height:220px;
  border:1px solid var(--iv-line);
  border-radius:20px;
  padding:24px;
}
.swot-card small{
  display:block;
  font-size:10px;
  letter-spacing:.11em;
  font-weight:800;
}
.swot-card b{
  display:block;
  font-size:19px;
  margin:9px 0 12px;
}
.swot-card ul{
  margin:0;
  padding-left:18px;
}
.swot-card li{
  margin:8px 0;
  color:#b4bec1!important;
}
.swot-s{border-left:3px solid #89d6b1!important}
.swot-w{border-left:3px solid var(--iv-gold)!important}
.swot-o{border-left:3px solid #78aee2!important}
.swot-t{border-left:3px solid #db7f73!important}
.swot-s small{color:#89d6b1!important}
.swot-w small{color:var(--iv-gold)!important}
.swot-o small{color:#78aee2!important}
.swot-t small{color:#db7f73!important}

/* nav follows same palette */
nav{
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(3,5,7,.9),rgba(3,5,7,.25),transparent)!important;
}
.logo,.brand{color:var(--iv-ink)!important}
.navlinks a,.links a{color:#b5c1c5!important}

/* mobile */
@media(max-width:900px){
  .benchmark-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
}
@media(max-width:620px){
  .benchmark-grid,.swot-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
}
</style>

<style id="v40-color-only-contrast">
/* =========================================================
   V40 — COLOR ONLY
   No layout / spacing / typography / structure changes.
   Page 1 dark, page 2 light, then strictly alternating.
   ========================================================= */

/* Force the 18 existing sections to alternate dark/light.
   The fake ID in :not() is only for selector specificity. */
html body > section:nth-of-type(odd):not(#__never_match__){
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 18% 12%,rgba(132,220,226,.055),transparent 28%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 84% 24%,rgba(154,140,255,.04),transparent 30%),
    linear-gradient(180deg,#05080b,#0a1117)!important;
  color:#ffffff!important;
}
html body > section:nth-of-type(even):not(#__never_match__){
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 82% 10%,rgba(111,168,255,.065),transparent 28%),
    linear-gradient(180deg,#f4f7f9,#e4eaee)!important;
  color:#111820!important;
}

/* DARK PAGE — all text defaults to high-contrast white */
html body > section:nth-of-type(odd):not(#__never_match__) *{
  color:#eef4f6!important;
  opacity:1!important;
}
html body > section:nth-of-type(odd):not(#__never_match__) h1,
html body > section:nth-of-type(odd):not(#__never_match__) h2,
html body > section:nth-of-type(odd):not(#__never_match__) h3,
html body > section:nth-of-type(odd):not(#__never_match__) h4,
html body > section:nth-of-type(odd):not(#__never_match__) b,
html body > section:nth-of-type(odd):not(#__never_match__) strong,
html body > section:nth-of-type(odd):not(#__never_match__) .section-title,
html body > section:nth-of-type(odd):not(#__never_match__) .display{
  color:#ffffff!important;
}
html body > section:nth-of-type(odd):not(#__never_match__) .kicker,
html body > section:nth-of-type(odd):not(#__never_match__) .tag,
html body > section:nth-of-type(odd):not(#__never_match__) small,
html body > section:nth-of-type(odd):not(#__never_match__) .label,
html body > section:nth-of-type(odd):not(#__never_match__) .n{
  color:#8fe4e9!important;
}
html body > section:nth-of-type(odd):not(#__never_match__) .key{
  color:#ffffff!important;
  background:linear-gradient(transparent 57%,rgba(78,222,231,.36) 0)!important;
}
html body > section:nth-of-type(odd):not(#__never_match__) .kpi b,
html body > section:nth-of-type(odd):not(#__never_match__) .rev-card b,
html body > section:nth-of-type(odd):not(#__never_match__) .retainer b,
html body > section:nth-of-type(odd):not(#__never_match__) .commercial-note b,
html body > section:nth-of-type(odd):not(#__never_match__) .scenario-row strong{
  color:#f3d99d!important;
}

/* LIGHT PAGE — dark navy text, never white/grey-on-grey */
html body > section:nth-of-type(even):not(#__never_match__) *{
  color:#18242d!important;
  opacity:1!important;
}
html body > section:nth-of-type(even):not(#__never_match__) h1,
html body > section:nth-of-type(even):not(#__never_match__) h2,
html body > section:nth-of-type(even):not(#__never_match__) h3,
html body > section:nth-of-type(even):not(#__never_match__) h4,
html body > section:nth-of-type(even):not(#__never_match__) b,
html body > section:nth-of-type(even):not(#__never_match__) strong,
html body > section:nth-of-type(even):not(#__never_match__) .section-title,
html body > section:nth-of-type(even):not(#__never_match__) .display{
  color:#0b1218!important;
}
html body > section:nth-of-type(even):not(#__never_match__) .kicker,
html body > section:nth-of-type(even):not(#__never_match__) .tag,
html body > section:nth-of-type(even):not(#__never_match__) small,
html body > section:nth-of-type(even):not(#__never_match__) .label,
html body > section:nth-of-type(even):not(#__never_match__) .n{
  color:#006c76!important;
}
html body > section:nth-of-type(even):not(#__never_match__) .key{
  color:#071116!important;
  background:linear-gradient(transparent 57%,rgba(0,138,150,.25) 0)!important;
}
html body > section:nth-of-type(even):not(#__never_match__) .kpi b,
html body > section:nth-of-type(even):not(#__never_match__) .rev-card b,
html body > section:nth-of-type(even):not(#__never_match__) .retainer b,
html body > section:nth-of-type(even):not(#__never_match__) .commercial-note b,
html body > section:nth-of-type(even):not(#__never_match__) .scenario-row strong{
  color:#6b4d08!important;
}

/* Existing card/module forms stay exactly the same; only surface colors change
   so their text always matches the page tone. */
html body > section:nth-of-type(odd):not(#__never_match__) :is(
  .problem,.benchmark-card,.story-node,.legend,.ops-item,.timeline,.journey,
  .member-engine,.engine-note,.ce-card,.growth-rhythm,.academy-card,.academy-path,
  .input,.engine,.pipe,.commercial,.model,.biz-flow,.rev-card,.cash-card,
  .finance-rules,.loop-card,.week,.kpi,.day,.online-ops,.online-op,.retainer,
  .team-structure,.team-card,.deliv,.metric-table,.swot-card,.road>div,.future-note,
  .thesis,.highlight-box
){
  background:#0d171e!important;
  border-color:#334752!important;
}
html body > section:nth-of-type(even):not(#__never_match__) :is(
  .problem,.benchmark-card,.story-node,.legend,.ops-item,.timeline,.journey,
  .member-engine,.engine-note,.ce-card,.growth-rhythm,.academy-card,.academy-path,
  .input,.engine,.pipe,.commercial,.model,.biz-flow,.rev-card,.cash-card,
  .finance-rules,.loop-card,.week,.kpi,.day,.online-ops,.online-op,.retainer,
  .team-structure,.team-card,.deliv,.metric-table,.swot-card,.road>div,.future-note,
  .thesis,.highlight-box
){
  background:#ffffff!important;
  border-color:#9ba9b3!important;
}

/* Table/grid lines only */
html body > section:nth-of-type(odd):not(#__never_match__) :is(
  .row,.metric,.scenario-row,.ops-row,.online-ops-grid,.team-grid,.legend-row
){
  border-color:#334752!important;
}
html body > section:nth-of-type(even):not(#__never_match__) :is(
  .row,.metric,.scenario-row,.ops-row,.online-ops-grid,.team-grid,.legend-row
){
  border-color:#9ba9b3!important;
}

/* Keep the four luxury image plates untouched visually */
html body .board-kv,
html body .board-kv *{
  color:inherit;
}

/* Nav stays dark and readable on both page tones */
html body nav{
  background:rgba(3,5,7,.94)!important;
}
html body nav *,
html body nav a{
  color:#f5f7f8!important;
}
</style>

</head>
<body>

<div class="scroll-progress" aria-hidden="true"><span></span></div>

      <a href="#partner">夥伴系統</a><a href="#oct">十月計畫</a><a href="#role">角色與交付</a>
    </div>

</nav>

<section id="cover" class="dark">
  <div class="wrap cover-grid">
    <div class="cover-copy">
      <div class="kicker">AI4NEXT / ARGO-01 · TAIPEI</div>
      <h1 class="display">EVERY ERA<br/>HAS ITS<br/><span style="color:#9ba3a9">VESSEL.</span></h1>
      <p>當 AI 正在快速改寫工作方式、產業流程與人的角色，我們真正需要的不是更多資訊，而是一個能讓<strong class="key">人、能力、問題與機會真正相遇</strong>的系統。</p>
      <div class="meta"><span>READ THE SIGNAL</span><span>找到同伴</span><span>完成任務</span><span>SHIFT YOUR ORBIT</span></div>
    </div>

    <div class="kv-stack reveal">
      <div class="board-kv cover-kv" aria-label="AI4NEXT 精品主視覺"><i class="signal-dot s1"></i><i class="signal-dot s2"></i></div>
      <div class="kv-note"><span><strong>AI4NEXT 的角色：把人、AI 與機會放進同一個故事系統。 KV</strong></span><span>AI4NEXT 的角色：把人、AI 與機會放進同一個故事系統。</span></div>
    </div>

  </div>
</section>

<section class="light">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="split">
      <div><div class="kicker">01 · 為什麼現在做</div><h2 class="section-title">把活動後消失的 <span class="key">Signal 留下來</span>。<br/><span class="goal-inline">目標：建立 AI4NEXT 作為持續運作的轉換機制。</span></h2></div>
      <p class="lead">企業有需求，人才有能力，活動也有人來。真正的缺口是：活動後沒有系統把 <strong class="key">Signal → Relationship → Opportunity</strong> 接起來。AI4NEXT 補上的，就是這層持續運作的轉換機制。</p>
    </div>
    <div class="problem-grid reveal">
      <div class="problem"><small>企業端</small><b>有問題，不知道找誰做</b><p>AI 導入常停在「想做」，缺少清楚題目、合適人才與從 Pilot 到下一步的路徑。</p></div>
      <div class="problem"><small>人才端</small><b>會做，但缺真實機會</b><p>履歷能寫技能，卻不一定能證明協作、解題與交付；需要真實 Mission 留下作品與紀錄。</p></div>
      <div class="problem"><small>活動端</small><b>人來了，關係沒有留下</b><p>活動後缺少 Profile、興趣 / 需求標籤、後續媒合與商務追蹤，Signal 因此重新散掉。</p></div>
      <div class="problem"><small>AI4NEXT</small><b>把 Signal 留下來並推進</b><p>用會員資料、LINE 分眾、內容、Mission、人才媒合與企業 Pipeline，讓每次相遇都有可追蹤的下一步。</p></div>
    </div>
    <div class="thesis">一句話定位：<strong>AI4NEXT 是把 OOPS 的人、活動與合作資源，轉成會員關係、作品、人才與企業機會的營運層。</strong></div><div class="highlight-box"><strong>這一頁要達成的重點：</strong>讓對方先理解「AI4NEXT 不是另一個活動品牌」，而是負責把 Signal 留下來並推進的系統。</div>
  </div>
</section>


<section id="benchmarks" class="dark2">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="split reveal">
      <div>
        <div class="kicker">MARKET BENCHMARKS / 海內外品牌參考</div>
        <h2 class="section-title">海內外都有人做其中一段。<br/><span class="key">AI4NEXT 要把幾段接成同一條路徑。</span></h2>
      </div>
      <p class="lead">以下不是一對一競品，而是已被市場驗證的不同功能模型。</p>
    </div>

    <div class="benchmark-grid reveal">
      <div class="benchmark-card">
        <small>TAIWAN · MARKETPLACE</small>
        <b>PRO360</b>
        <p>需求刊登、專業服務人才、案件媒合。</p>
        <span>參考：台灣的需求 ↔ 專業服務媒合模型。</span>
      </div>
      <div class="benchmark-card">
        <small>TAIWAN · STARTUP EVENT</small>
        <b>InnoVEX</b>
        <p>Startup 展會、Pitch、VC / CVC、國際舞台。</p>
        <span>參考：產業活動與新創展示；AI4NEXT 補上活動後的媒合。</span>
      </div>
      <div class="benchmark-card">
        <small>TAIWAN · ACCELERATOR</small>
        <b>AppWorks</b>
        <p>Founder network、企業 BD、Demo Day、人才與投資資源。</p>
        <span>參考：高品質 curated network 可帶來 BD、人才與資本機會。</span>
      </div>
      <div class="benchmark-card">
        <small>GLOBAL · TALENT</small>
        <b>Braintrust</b>
        <p>全球專業人才、AI matching、企業用人與團隊配置。</p>
        <span>參考：企業願意為更快、更準的人才匹配付費。</span>
      </div>
      <div class="benchmark-card">
        <small>GLOBAL · CHALLENGE</small>
        <b>Devpost</b>
        <p>企業與組織可管理 Hackathon、參與者與作品。</p>
        <span>參考：Challenge 可同時做企業創新與人才驗證。</span>
      </div>
      <div class="benchmark-card">
        <small>GLOBAL · FESTIVAL + MATCH</small>
        <b>Slush</b>
        <p>大型活動、Meeting Tool、Side Events、Founder / Investor matching。</p>
        <span>參考：Festival 可以是全年網絡的高峰，而不是一次性活動。</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section id="story" class="dark">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="split">
      <div><div class="kicker">02 · 品牌故事 / ARGO NAVIS</div><h2 class="section-title">建立 AI4NEXT 的品牌世界觀。<br/><span class="goal-inline">目標：讓人一眼看懂它是如何把人、AI 與機會接起來。</span></h2></div>
      <p class="lead">古人曾把 Argo Navis 想像成天空中的一艘船。對 AI4NEXT 而言，這個故事最重要的不是單一英雄，而是<strong class="key">一群能力不同的人，在沒有完整地圖時，仍選擇一起出發</strong>。</p>
    </div>
    <div class="story-grid reveal">

      <div class="kv-stack reveal">
        <div class="board-kv story-kv" aria-label="AI4NEXT 品牌故事主視覺"><i class="signal-dot s1"></i><i class="signal-dot s2"></i></div>
        <div class="kv-note"><span><strong>BRAND STORY / ARGO NAVIS</strong></span><span>品牌故事：讓人理解 AI4NEXT 為何存在，以及它如何運作。</span></div>
      </div>

      <div class="story-copy">
        <div class="kicker">一個古老故事，重新編碼給現在</div>
        <h3>今天，地圖又失效了一次。</h3>
        <p>AI 正在重新寫工作方式、產業流程與人的角色。真正稀缺的，不只是工具，而是<strong class="key">辨認訊號、找到同伴，並把可能性做成真實結果</strong>的能力。</p>
        <p><strong style="color:#eeece6">AI4NEXT 是屬於這個時代的 Argo。</strong> 人帶著自己的經驗、能力、野心與問題上船；AI 像星圖與羅盤，提供方向；OOPS 是承載整艘船的基地；而每一次 Mission，都是一次離開舊軌道的航行。</p>
        <div class="legend">
          <div class="legend-row"><b>ARGO</b><span>飛船：讓不同能力的人組成 Crew。</span></div>
          <div class="legend-row"><b>CARINA</b><span>基地：OOPS，承載場域、社群與真實連結。</span></div>
          <div class="legend-row"><b>PYXIS</b><span>羅盤：AI，協助導航，但不替人決定目的地。</span></div>
          <div class="legend-row"><b>JANUS</b><span>門：每個 Next，都是從舊狀態跨進新狀態。</span></div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="visual-archive">
      
      <div class="visual-label">PEOPLE × AI × REAL EXPERIENCES</div>
    </div>

    <div class="story-path reveal">
      <div class="story-node"><small>01 · SIGNAL</small><b>出現訊號</b><span>一個問題、能力、野心或新的可能開始出現。</span></div>
      <div class="story-node"><small>02 · NAVIGATION</small><b>看見路徑</b><span>AI 幫助拆解問題、辨認方向與可能組合。</span></div>
      <div class="story-node"><small>03 · CREW</small><b>找到同伴</b><span>人才、Founder、企業、Mentor 與資源開始靠近。</span></div>
      <div class="story-node"><small>04 · MISSION</small><b>做出成果</b><span>Lab、Challenge、Project 把關係變成共同成果。</span></div>
      <div class="story-node"><small>05 · NEXT</small><b>進入新軌道</b><span>新的合作、職涯、事業、市場或下一個自己。</span></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section id="oops" class="light">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="split">
      <div><div class="kicker">03 · OOPS 線上 × 線下營運系統</div><h2 class="section-title">把 OOPS 從活動場地，變成能累積會員與機會的基地。<br/><span class="goal-inline">目標：讓每場活動都接回同一套營運系統。</span></h2></div>
      <p class="lead">線下負責聚人與建立信任；線上負責把活動、會員、內容、Partner 與商務接起來。<strong class="key">AI4NEXT 先跑通第一條 Opportunity Track。</strong></p>
    </div>

    <div class="kv-stack reveal">
      <div class="board-kv oops-kv" aria-label="OOPS 精品營運主視覺"><i class="signal-dot s1"></i><i class="signal-dot s2"></i></div>
      <div class="kv-note"><span><strong>OOPS / OPERATING SYSTEM</strong></span><span>OOPS / CARINA BASE</span></div>
    </div>

    <div class="ops-grid reveal">
      <div class="ops-item"><small>01 · PROGRAM</small><b>月主題與活動架構</b><ul><li>每月一條清楚主線</li><li>免費入口 → 深度體驗 → Flagship</li><li>不同 Lane 互相導流</li><li>每場活動都有下一步 CTA</li></ul></div>
      <div class="ops-item"><small>02 · TRAFFIC</small><b>內容與 Partner 導流</b><ul><li>以 3–5 個合作節點為月度推進目標</li><li>每個入口有來源碼</li><li>重新觸達 OOPS 既有會員</li><li>內容服務同一個月度目標</li></ul></div>
      <div class="ops-item"><small>03 · MEMBER</small><b>LINE 會員與分眾</b><ul><li>建立 opt-in 會員入口</li><li>依興趣與行為標籤</li><li>不對所有人群發</li><li>留下活動與下一步紀錄</li></ul></div>
      <div class="ops-item"><small>04 · CONVERSION</small><b>每次活動都推進一格</b><ul><li>Open Session → Mission / Lab</li><li>Mission → Work / Profile</li><li>Work → Demo / Match</li><li>Match → Project / Course / B2B</li></ul></div>
      <div class="ops-item"><small>05 · PARTNER</small><b>品牌與企業合作</b><ul><li>先定義對方想要的成果</li><li>再設計活動與交付</li><li>不出售原始會員名單</li><li>用成果推下一階段合作</li></ul></div>
      <div class="ops-item"><small>06 · DATA</small><b>營運數據與決策節奏</b><ul><li>來源 → 入會 → 參與 → 下一步</li><li>每週 Decision Log</li><li>月底 Go / Adjust / Stop</li><li>只放大已驗證有效的產品</li></ul></div>
    </div>


    <div class="visual-archive">
      
      <div class="visual-label">OOPS · EXPERIENCE → CONNECTION → VALUE</div>
    </div>

    <div class="timeline reveal">
      <div class="row head"><span>節點</span><span>線上營運</span><span>會員 / LINE</span><span>商業 / 活動</span></div>
      <div class="row"><b>月初</b><span>定主題、活動月曆、Partner Brief</span><span>標籤 / 來源 / CTA 設定</span><span>合作方案、報名頁、活動上架</span></div>
      <div class="row"><b>活動前 14–7 天</b><span>內容與 Partner 導流</span><span>興趣回收與分眾</span><span>講師、Partner、活動條件確認</span></div>
      <div class="row"><b>活動週</b><span>最後推播與來源檢查</span><span>提醒、到場、下一步選擇</span><span>Open / Lab / Flagship</span></div>
      <div class="row"><b>活動後 48H</b><span>回顧、歸因、資料整理</span><span>依行為分眾 follow-up</span><span>Partner report / Lead</span></div>
      <div class="row"><b>活動後 7D</b><span>Case / Portfolio / 下一輪內容</span><span>下一場 / 下一 Mission 推薦</span><span>B2B / Challenge / Project</span></div>
      <div class="row"><b>月底</b><span>月報與下月建議</span><span>成長 / 回訪 / Activation</span><span>Pipeline 與續合作決策</span></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section id="member" class="dark2">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="split">
      <div><div class="kicker">04 · OOPS 會員旅程</div><h2 class="section-title">先用 LINE 建立第一版會員系統。<br/><span class="goal-inline">目標：讓每次互動都有下一步，而不是只留報名表。</span></h2></div>
      <p class="lead">LINE 先作為會員系統第一版。活動、Partner 與內容進同一個入口，再依興趣分流到 <strong class="key">社交、學習、共創、身心與機會</strong>。</p>
    </div>

    <div class="journey reveal">
      <div class="jstep"><small>01 · 來源</small><b>活動 / Partner / 內容</b><span>每個入口都保留來源碼，知道會員從哪裡來。</span></div>
      <div class="jstep"><small>02 · 入口</small><b>Send Your Signal</b><span>角色、能力、興趣、正在找什麼。</span></div>
      <div class="jstep"><small>03 · 入會</small><b>LINE OA</b><span>取得同意後建立可持續關係，而不是只留報名表。</span></div>
      <div class="jstep"><small>04 · 分眾</small><b>依興趣 / 行為標籤</b><span>社交、學習、共創、身心、Opportunity。</span></div>

      <p class="lead">10 月仍是 Pilot，不先寫死大型 Sponsor 價格。<strong class="key">第一階段只驗證一件事：企業是否願意付費進入 Pilot、正式報價或下一步合作。</strong></p>

        <div class="kicker">企業真正購買的是什麼</div>

        <p>企業可從產品教育、品牌內容、人才接觸、Employer Branding、Innovation Challenge 或真實 Use Case 切入。AI4NEXT 把需求轉成 Program / Mission；OOPS 提供實體基地與社群場景；成果再延伸 Training、Project 或 PoC。</p>

        <div class="model"><b>Program 合作</b><div><span>Open Session + Mission / Lab + OOPS 實體匯流 + 成果回顧。</span><em>依場次、製作與交付深度報價</em></div></div>
        <div class="model"><b>Challenge / 創新合作</b><div><span>企業題目、Builder 徵集、Demo 與後續 opt-in 洽談。</span><em>確認 Scope 後另案報價</em></div></div>

      <div><b>3 · Repeat</b><span>相同結構複製到第二個主題或 Partner。</span></div>

<section id="revenue" class="dark2">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="split">
      <div>
        <div class="kicker">09 · REVENUE FORECAST / 贊助與營收管理</div>
        <h2 class="section-title">用 Pipeline 到 Collected 管理營收。<br/><span class="goal-inline">目標：不是只看漂亮數字，而是看真正收到多少錢。</span></h2>
      </div>
      <p class="lead">首階段以企業合作為主要商業引擎，票券與會員收入為補充。金額都是規劃假設；真正管理的是 <strong class="key">Pipeline、簽約、開票、收款與直接成本</strong>。</p>    </div>

    <div class="rev-models reveal">
      <div class="rev-card">
        <small>01 · 內容 / 主題合作</small>
        <b>NT$ 20K–40K / 案</b>
        <p>品牌內容、案例、講者、產品體驗或單場主題合作。</p>
        <span>適合第一階段快速驗證 Partner 意願。</span>
      </div>
      <div class="rev-card">
        <small>02 · Program Partner</small>
        <b>NT$ 40K–80K / 案</b>
        <p>Open Session + Mission / Lab + OOPS 實體匯流 + 成果回顧。</p>
        <span>較完整的合作單位，可對應品牌教育、人才接觸或產品應用。</span>
      </div>
      <div class="rev-card">
        <small>03 · Corporate Pilot / Challenge</small>
        <b>NT$ 80K–150K+ / 案</b>
        <p>企業題目、Builder 徵集、Demo、Training、PoC 前期驗證。</p>
        <span>依 Scope、講師、製作、技術與交付深度另行報價。</span>
      </div>
      <div class="rev-card">
        <small>04 · 票券 / 會員</small>
        <b>Secondary Revenue</b>
        <p>Open Session、Workshop、Mission、Bundle 或會員方案。</p>
        <span>首階段不把 C 端票房當成唯一商業假設。</span>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="scenario-title">
      <div>
        <div class="kicker">MONTHLY SCENARIOS / 月營收情境</div>
        <h3>用三種情境管理，不用一個漂亮數字假裝一定做得到。</h3>
      </div>
      <p>以下只作為首階段營運預估。實際報價仍依合作範圍、直接成本與企業需求調整。</p>
    </div>

    <div class="scenario-table reveal">
      <div class="scenario-row head">
        <span>情境</span><span>企業合作</span><span>票券 / 會員</span><span>預估月營收</span><span>重點</span>
      </div>
      <div class="scenario-row">
        <b>保守</b><span>1 個主題合作 + 1 個 Program</span><span>0–20K</span><strong>NT$ 60K–120K</strong><span>先驗證願付費與交付流程。</span>
      </div>
      <div class="scenario-row">
        <b>基準</b><span>2 個主題合作 + 1 個 Program + 1 個 Pilot</span><span>20K–40K</span><strong>NT$ 180K–280K</strong><span>開始形成可重複的月營收結構。</span>
      </div>
      <div class="scenario-row">
        <b>成長</b><span>2–3 個 Partner + 1–2 個 Pilot / Challenge</span><span>30K–60K</span><strong>NT$ 300K–450K+</strong><span>前提是已有案例、轉換率與穩定交付能力。</span>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="revenue-note reveal">
      <b>首階段最重要的不是衝高 GMV。</b>
      <span>而是確認：哪一種合作最容易成交、交付成本多少、哪些 Partner 能續約，以及會員與企業 Pipeline 是否真的能帶來下一輪收入。</span>
    </div>

    <div class="cash-grid reveal">
      <div class="cash-card">
        <small>PIPELINE</small><b>預估商機</b>
        <p>記錄金額、Stage、決策者、預計成交日、下一步；不能把 Pipeline 當營收。</p>
      </div>
      <div class="cash-card">
        <small>SIGNED</small><b>已簽約</b>
        <p>合約確認後才進 Forecast；大型專案建議收 50% 啟動款。</p>
      </div>
      <div class="cash-card">
        <small>INVOICED</small><b>已開票 / 請款</b>
        <p>所有合作都要有請款節點，不以口頭承諾安排大量製作。</p>
      </div>
      <div class="cash-card">
        <small>COLLECTED</small><b>已收款</b>
        <p>實際現金流以到帳為準；月報同時看應收帳款與逾期天數。</p>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="finance-rules reveal">
      <div>
        <small>01 · 每案 P&L</small>
        <b>每個 Program 都有獨立損益</b>
        <span>營收 − 場地 − 講師 − 設計 / 製作 − 廣告 − 技術 − 其他直接成本。</span>
      </div>
      <div>
        <small>02 · 毛利底線</small>
        <b>先看 Contribution Margin</b>
        <span>如果合作只增加工作量卻沒有留下毛利、會員或企業資產，就不應無限擴張。</span>
      </div>
      <div>
        <small>03 · 收款節點</small>
        <b>先收款，再啟動高成本製作</b>
        <span>小案可全額預付；中大型案建議 50% 啟動、50% 交付 / 活動前結清。</span>
      </div>
      <div>
        <small>04 · 月度 Dashboard</small>
        <b>營收與營運一起看</b>
        <span>Revenue、Collected Cash、AR、Gross Margin、Partner Renewal、Lead → Pilot Conversion。</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<script id="v30-motion-js">
(() => {
  // scroll reveal
  const io = new IntersectionObserver((entries)=>{
    entries.forEach(e=>{
      if(e.isIntersecting){ e.target.classList.add('on'); io.unobserve(e.target); }
    });
  }, {threshold:.10, rootMargin:'0px 0px -6% 0px'});
  document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach(el=>io.observe(el));

  // subtle starfield, adapted from v17
  const c=document.getElementById('stars');
  if(c && !matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches){
    const x=c.getContext('2d'); let stars=[];
    function size(){
      const dpr=Math.min(devicePixelRatio||1,2);
      c.width=innerWidth*dpr;c.height=innerHeight*dpr;
      c.style.width=innerWidth+'px';c.style.height=innerHeight+'px';
      x.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);
      const n=Math.min(100,Math.max(45,Math.floor(innerWidth/15)));
      stars=Array.from({length:n},()=>({
        x:Math.random()*innerWidth,y:Math.random()*innerHeight,
        r:Math.random()*.8+.15,a:Math.random()*.34+.08,s:Math.random()*.045+.01
      }));
    }
    function draw(){
      x.clearRect(0,0,innerWidth,innerHeight);
      for(const s of stars){
        s.y+=s.s;if(s.y>innerHeight)s.y=0;
        x.beginPath();x.arc(s.x,s.y,s.r,0,Math.PI*2);
        x.fillStyle=`rgba(255,255,255,${s.a})`;x.fill();
      }
      requestAnimationFrame(draw);
    }
    size();draw();addEventListener('resize',size,{passive:true});
  }

  // scroll progress
  const progressEl=document.querySelector('.scroll-progress span');
  function updateProgress(){
    const h=document.documentElement.scrollHeight-innerHeight;
    const p=h>0?scrollY/h*100:0;
    if(progressEl) progressEl.style.width=p+'%';
  }
  addEventListener('scroll',updateProgress,{passive:true}); updateProgress();

  // KPI count-up, adapted from v17
  const countEls=[...document.querySelectorAll('.kpi b')];
  const countIO=new IntersectionObserver(entries=>entries.forEach(e=>{
    if(!e.isIntersecting||e.target.dataset.done)return;
    const raw=e.target.textContent.trim();
    const m=raw.match(/^(\d+)(?:[–-](\d+))?(\+)?$/);
    if(!m)return;
    e.target.dataset.done='1';
    const hi=parseInt(m[2]||m[1]), lo=m[2]?m[1]+'–':'', plus=m[3]||'';
    const start=performance.now(), dur=850;
    function tick(t){
      const q=Math.min(1,(t-start)/dur);
      const v=Math.round(hi*(1-Math.pow(1-q,3)));
      e.target.textContent=lo+v+plus;
      if(q<1)requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }),{threshold:.7});
  countEls.forEach(el=>countIO.observe(el));
})();
</script>

</body>
